interfaceDesign: ArchiveRecords(workspaceDir, archiveDir, root string) error — root is the repository root; an empty root leaves archived content unchanged, matching today's behavior at every existing call site.
relativizeRunPaths(content []byte, root string) []byte — unexported; strips every occurrence of root+separator from content, no-op when root is empty.
copyRelativized(source, target, root string) error — unexported sibling to copyIfPresent; missing source is a no-op, writes relativizeRunPaths(content, root) instead of raw bytes.

archiveTypedState(workspaceDir, archiveDir, root string) error and copyStageDocuments(entries, sourceDir, targetDir, root string) error — root threaded through to copyRelativized for .json stage documents.

recordEpisode resolves root via filepath.Abs(".") (mirroring run.go's prepareRunWorkspace) and passes it to memory.ArchiveRecords; a resolution failure is reported to stderr and root falls back to "" so the strip no-ops rather than aborting the run.

keyDecisions.decision: Implemented exactly the architecture-notes.md plan: ArchiveRecords grows a third root parameter, a full-byte-content substring strip (not field-by-field JSON rewriting), and root is resolved independently in recordEpisode via filepath.Abs(".") rather than threaded from run.go.
keyDecisions.reasoning: architecture-notes.md already worked through the alternatives (options struct, boolean flag, threading ProjectRoot through run.go) and rejected each with a stated trade-off; re-deriving the same analysis during implementation would have added risk without adding information.

keyDecisions.decision: Extracted mustReadFile in ingest_test.go rather than leaving TestArchiveLeavesTheWorkspaceByteIdentical as one block.
